title: AWS DMS Failures by Task
app: AWS Database Migration Service task events via CloudWatch to the Splunk Add-on for AWS.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=aws:dms:task status="failed" OR status="stopped"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by replication_task
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts AWS DMS failures grouped by task so operators immediately see which specific tasks are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'AWS DMS is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest AWS DMS failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical tasks.
visualization: Table of task by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of AWS DMS are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
